Archiv.et: From Late Latin archīvum (“public records office”).

Architekt.et: Borrowed from Latin architectus, from Ancient Greek ἀρχιτέκτων (arkhitéktōn).

Archäologie.et: From Latin archaeologia, from Ancient Greek ἀρχαιολογίᾱ (arkhaiologíā).

archaisch.et: From Late Latin archaicus, itself from Ancient Greek ἀρχαϊκός (arkhaïkós).
